_meta.purpose: Known, reviewed differences between authored card copy and data/generated/scorecard.json.
_meta.how_it_works: An entry suppresses a drift finding ONLY when BOTH the authored and official strings still match exactly. If either side changes — someone edits a guide, or fetch_school_data.py pulls a new vintage — the waiver stops matching and the drift is reported again. A baseline entry can therefore never hide a future change.
_meta.adding_an_entry: Run scripts/check_drift.py, confirm the difference is real and intended, then record it here with a reason that says WHY it is acceptable. Do not add entries to silence a genuine mistake — fix the guide instead.
